lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li6Mg3Cr3O12 (reduced formula Li2MgCrO4) is monoclinic, space group C2 (No. 5), with 24 atoms in the unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cr and Mg each as octahedrally coordinated by six O neighbors, while Li shows four O neighbors and O adopts a trigonal bipyramidal environment with three Li, one Mg, and one Cr neighbor. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between O trigonal bipyramids and corner-sharing between Cr and Mg octahedra.
